meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调用 lark-cli 读取你的日历日程和未完成待办，整理成带表格的日期摘要，并给出冲突提醒和空闲时段。仅支持 user 身份，需先授权。
howto.when: 当你想了解今天、明天或本周的安排时触发，比如问「今天有什么安排」「明天有什么会」。使用前需完成 lark-cli 授权。

say.text: 帮我生成今天的日程和待办摘要
say.note: 输出带表格的日期摘要

say.text: 看看明天有什么会，还有哪些任务没做完
say.note: 覆盖明日日程与未完成待办

say.text: 这周还有哪些安排？给我一份开工摘要

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs lark-cli to pull your calendar agenda and unfinished tasks, then formats a dated summary with a schedule table, to-do list, conflict alerts and free slots. User identity only; authorize calendar and task first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about today's, tomorrow's or this week's schedule, e.g. "what's on today" or "any meetings tomorrow". Requires lark-cli authorization first.

say_en.text: Generate today's schedule and to-do summary
What meetings and unfinished tasks do I have tomorrow?
say_en.note: Covers tomorrow's agenda and open tasks

say_en.text: What's left this week? Give me a standup report
